description: This file contains utility functions and exports related to daemon management, runtime status, environment filtering, and CLI command formatting for the openclaw project. It includes functions for creating daemon contexts, handling runtime status colors, parsing ports, and generating hints for runtime and service start procedures.

methods.name: createDaemonInstallActionContext
methods.description: Creates a context object for daemon installation, including a JSON flag and invoking createDaemonActionContext with action 'install'.

methods.name: failIfNixDaemonInstallMode
methods.description: Checks if Nix mode is active; if so, calls a fail callback with a message indicating service install is disabled.

methods.name: createCliStatusTextStyles
methods.description: Returns an object with methods to generate styled CLI status texts based on theme and richness.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a function that maps a runtime status string to a theme color function.

methods.name: parsePortFromArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract a port number if specified with '--port' or '--port='.

methods.name: pickProbeHostForBind
methods.description: Determines the probe host address based on bind mode, tailnet IP, and optional custom host.

methods.name: filterDaemonEnv
methods.description: Filters environment variables to include only safe keys related to daemon configuration.

methods.name: safeDaemonEnv
methods.description: Converts filtered environment variables into an array of 'KEY=VALUE' strings.

methods.name: normalizeListenerAddress
methods.description: Normalizes a listener address string by removing protocol and LISTEN annotations.

methods.name: renderRuntimeHints
methods.description: Generates hints for runtime status, including logs and installation status messages.

methods.name: renderGatewayServiceStartHints
methods.description: Provides hints for starting the gateway service, including commands and container management.

methods.name: filterContainerGenericHints
methods.description: Filters out container-specific hints if the environment is within a container.
